# The course-hand SVGs (shore_*.svg)

*wf6 scratch. Generated by `python3 wf6/render_shore.py --all`, which rewrites every file listed here and this index. Built to `wf6/shoreland_spec.md` §6 and §7; the renderer's resolutions are in that spec's "Renderer notes" section. Check with `python3 wf6/render_shore.py --selftest`.*

## Using them

- **Colour.** Every stroke is `currentColor` under the class `stone-ink`. Inline the SVG and set `.stone-ink { color: var(--stone-ink); }` (the Legends page's stone ink is `#ece5cf`). Standalone, or as an `<img>`, a file falls back to `#e4dbc2` in a dark colour scheme and `#3d3326` in a light one (`--ink` bakes another).
- **Strength.** CSS variables on any ancestor: `--cut-shade-alpha` (default .3; set 1 for a solid stroke in body text), `--bed-alpha` (.4, the mortar), `--bite-alpha` (.95), `--joint-alpha` (.13, the stone outline), `--coal-alpha` (.9), `--label-alpha` (.72, the charts' labels).
- **Size.** The viewBox is 10 user units per cell unit (u), and width/height default to 8 px per u (9 for the charts; the coal Title is 1.2x). Scale freely. For body text, a one-line render (`--measure 0`) set at `height: 1.55em` is legible; images 72 px tall or less strengthen their own facets.
- **Accessibility.** Each file is `role="img"` with a `<title>` carrying the English and a `<desc>` carrying the Orrowen and the hand. `shore_seren_locked.svg` shows the §6.15 locked form: its title is "A leaf in the course-hand, not yet read", it has no `<desc>`, and no English or Orrowen appears anywhere in the file (`--locked`).
- **Ids.** Each file's ids start `sh-<name>-`, so any number can be inlined on one page.
- **Preview.** `wf6/course/preview/preview.html` shows every file inline on the Legends dark page, at display size and in body text (`make_preview.py` rebuilds it, `shot.sh` screenshots it headless).

## The texts, as the renderer read them

Each line is given as the Book spells it and as the letter string the hand writes (§7 token form: `^S` `^N` bites, `A` `O` harmonic letters, `,` wedge, `|` perpend, `#gate`, `=` sealing lintel; this renderer adds `+` for a ligature's half head-joint, `_` after a Hal long vowel and `#` before a numeral). For §7.1-§7.10 the letter strings equal the spec's own, checked by `--selftest`.
